description: The Langfuse export (SPEC.md "Langfuse export"): event -> OTLP span and request body, event -> score payloads, settings -> status line, store line -> exportable. `expected` is generated from the Python reference by scripts/gen-langfuse-fixtures.py; `bodies_sha256` pins the exact request bytes, which the Node SDK must reproduce byte for byte.

cases.name: own-trace-generation
cases.description: No active span at call time: the exporter creates the trace (ids from sha256(event_id)), a generation with model, usage (cached tokens split out) and TryAii's cost; all three scores.

cases.name: child-of-active-span
cases.description: otel recorded: the TryAii span is a child of that span in that trace, observation type span (no model, usage or cost: Langfuse's own generation carries them). Winner = anchor (stay) and zero savings.

cases.name: error-no-recommendation
cases.description: A failed call: no usage, no costs, no winner (route skipped). Level ERROR with the error class and status; only the route_status score. Unknown app id: tryaii_url falls back to the monitor overview.

cases.name: reasoning-stream-absolute-path
cases.description: usage.reasoning_tokens (API v1.7) split from the output; a stream; an absolute Windows call_site path reduced to its base name; a process name with a space and non-ASCII text percent-encoded in tryaii_url.

cases.name: invalid-otel-ignored
cases.description: An otel value that is not a valid span (all-zero span id; upper-case trace id) is ignored: the exporter creates its own trace.

cases.name: tiny-money-and-null-latency
cases.description: Money below 1e-4 keeps the Node number format in every JSON string (0.000001, not 1e-06); no latency: end time = start time; whole-second ts; mode dynamic after a swap.

cases.name: tryaii-parent-for-langfuse
cases.description: Langfuse's OpenAI integration and no active span: the wrapper made the TryAii span the active parent (otel.origin = tryaii, ids from sha256(event_id)). The TryAii span is the trace root with exactly those ids, observation type span (Langfuse's generation, its child, carries model, usage and cost), trace name and tryaii_url set.

cases.name: unknown-origin-is-a-child
cases.description: Any other origin value is ignored: an otel span is a parent as usual.

cases.name: batch-of-two
cases.description: Two events in one OTLP request (one resourceSpans, one scope, spans in store order); scores per event.

cases.name: unset
cases.description: No switch: off, and status prints no line.

cases.name: on-without-app-key
cases.description: Switch on, no TryAii app key.

cases.name: on-bad-app-key
cases.description: Switch on, a value that is not an app key.

settings.reason: TRYAII_API_KEY is not an app key

expected.status_line: langfuse: off (TRYAII_API_KEY is not an app key)

cases.name: on-without-langfuse-keys
cases.description: Switch on, app key, Langfuse secret key missing.

expected.status_line: langfuse: off (LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY and LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY are needed)

cases.name: on-default-host
cases.description: Everything set, no host: Langfuse Cloud (EU).

cases.name: on-host-trimmed
cases.description: Switch value trimmed and case-insensitive; LANGFUSE_HOST with a trailing slash.

cases.name: base-url-wins
cases.description: LANGFUSE_BASE_URL wins over LANGFUSE_HOST.

cases.name: empty-base-url-skipped
cases.description: A blank LANGFUSE_BASE_URL falls through to LANGFUSE_HOST.

cases.name: switch-off-value
cases.description: Any other switch value is off; status says only 'langfuse: off'.

cases.name: exportable-event
cases.description: A v2 event line is exported.

cases.name: slice-1-line-skipped
cases.description: A line without a uuid event_id (slice 1) is never exported.

cases.name: forbidden-field-skipped
cases.description: A line with a forbidden field (the uploader's hard rule) is never exported.

cases.name: other-schema-skipped
cases.description: A vector line is not an event.

cases.name: bad-ts-skipped
cases.description: An event whose ts cannot be parsed has no span time and is skipped.
